label: Infectious etiologies of conjunctival tumors.
summary: Infectious agents have been associated with a variety of conjunctival tumors, including lymphoma, ocular surface squamous neoplasia (OSSN), papilloma, and Kaposi sarcoma. We discuss the infectious etiologies of certain conjunctival tumors including conjunctival lymphoma ( It is important for the clinician to recognize when tumors of the conjunctiva may be infection-associated.
